usages.explain: 「おまけに」is used to add additional characteristics or qualities to the person, thing, or situation being talked about. It is often used in everyday conversations.

examples.content: 日本の夏は暑いし、おまけに湿気も多いです。
examples.transcription: にほんのなつはあついし、おまけにしっけもおおいです。
examples.mean: Summer in Japan is hot and humid.

examples.content: 競馬で負け、おまけに帰りに財布を落とし、最悪だ。
examples.transcription: けいばでまけ、おまけにかえりにさいふをおとし、さいあくだ。
examples.mean: I lost at a horse race, and on top of that, I lost my wallet on the way home, which was the worst thing ever.

examples.content: あのそば屋は高いし、まずい。おまけにサービスも悪い。
examples.transcription: あのそばやはたかいし、まずい。おまけにサービスもわるい。
examples.mean: That soba restaurant is expensive and tastes bad. On top of that, the service is also bad.

title: おまけに => to make matters worse; besides; what's more; in addition; on top of that​
